tools.name: MLC Public Work Search
tools.what: Look up who owns which share of a song in the MLC database. Shows ownership data only, not what a song has earned.
tools.note: Tools page says anyone may use it at no charge.

tools.name: MLC Missing Member Lookup
tools.what: Search a name to see whether the MLC may hold US digital mechanicals for a rightsholder who has not joined. Leaves out historical unmatched money.

tools.name: MLC royalty dashboards
tools.what: Public charts of blanket, historical and unclaimed accrued royalties by month and by service. Totals only, nothing per song or per person.
tools.note: Three dashboards; the unclaimed one covers 2021 usage.

tools.name: MLC Matching and Claiming tools
tools.what: Member tools to claim missing shares of registered songs and to propose links between unmatched recordings and your songs.
tools.note: The tools page places them in the Member Hub but does not say whether login is required or free.

tools.name: Django Music Publisher
tools.what: Open-source software you host yourself to keep song metadata, register works and handle publishing royalty data.
tools.note: MIT licence per the repository; needs technical skill to run.

tools.name: Songview
tools.what: Landing page for the joint US performance-rights ownership data, with links out to the ASCAP and BMI public searches.
tools.note: Page describes the system but not login or cost of the searches it links to.

tools.name: BMI Repertoire
tools.what: Search BMI's catalogue for works, writers and publishers to see ownership shares held at BMI.
tools.note: Page showed only a human-verification form to automated reading; open by hand to confirm.

tools.name: ASCAP ACE Repertory
tools.what: Search ASCAP's repertory for works and their ownership data.
tools.note: Blocked automated reading (403). Open by hand to confirm what it shows and any login.

tools.name: SESAC Repertory
tools.what: Search SESAC's repertory for works it licenses.
tools.note: Blocked automated reading (403). Open by hand to confirm.

tools.name: PRS works search
tools.what: Search the PRS works database by title, writer, publisher or code. Reaches full detail through a member account.
tools.note: Search results suggest member login; a public view was not confirmed.

tools.name: GEMA repertoire search
tools.what: Link to GEMA's online works search, set beside a separate login and registration option.
tools.note: Page links to the search but does not say whether login is needed or what it omits.

tools.name: ISRC Search
tools.what: Look up recording identifiers (ISRCs) held in SoundExchange data, to find or check a code for a track.
tools.note: The tool page is script-driven; only the SoundExchange home page describes it as free and open.

tools.name: ISWC Network
tools.what: Portal for looking up and managing international identifiers (ISWC) for musical works.
tools.note: Page content did not load for automated reading; access level unconfirmed.

tools.name: ISNI database
tools.what: Public database of persistent identifiers for creators and organisations, useful to tell similarly named people apart.
tools.note: Home page links to a search but does not say whether search is free or needs login.

tools.name: US Copyright Office Public Records
tools.what: Search copyright registrations and recorded documents held by the Copyright Office.
tools.note: Page content did not load for automated reading; coverage and access unconfirmed.

tools.name: DDEX Validator
tools.what: Online checker for delivery messages in the DDEX standard before sending them to a service.
tools.note: Page content did not load for automated reading; supported messages and access unconfirmed.

tools.name: Curve Royalty Tools
tools.what: Royalty calculation tools from a statement-software vendor.
tools.note: Fetch returned HTTP 402; whether it is free, login or paid is unconfirmed.

tools.name: Session Studio
tools.what: Collaboration app that records who did what on a song, to settle credits before release.
tools.note: Page says the app is free; it does not state whether an account is required.

tools.name: RapidCue
tools.what: Web app for submitting cue sheets, with links to ASCAP and BMI.
tools.note: Page does not state what it does, who may use it, or the cost.

tools.name: ValuePunks
tools.what: Catalogue valuation tool that gives a quick indicative range from revenue by rights type.
tools.note: Page says free for artists, labels and songwriters; login need not confirmed.

tools.name: Music Business Toolbox
tools.what: Set of templates and calculators for splits, budgets and contracts, with a free tier and a paid tier.
tools.note: Page lists free and premium tiers; which tools are free and whether login is needed is unclear.

tools.name: Songtrust resource centre
tools.what: Guides, checklists and a split sheet from a publishing administrator, plus a streaming-royalty estimator.
tools.note: Page does not say which items are free or need an email.

tools.name: Harry Fox Agency
tools.what: Publisher-side rights agency; its older public Songfile search is a possible lookup.
tools.note: Blocked automated reading (403). Open by hand to confirm what it offers today.
